dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge defining a smooth parabolic curve from the posterior insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Moderate pixel radius exhibiting a rounded shape; lacks sharp angularity at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 35-40 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge, with a slight increase in steepness near the mid-section.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Measured at approximately 1.8:1, comparing the visible base width to the maximum vertical height of the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two distinct clusters of light-colored, linear rake marks (cicatrizes) on the lower lateral surface; an irregular dark pigmented patch or lesion is visible on the upper mid-section of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible tonal mottling and varying shades of grey across the lateral surface of the fin and the adjacent dorsal ridge.
